selection_basis: 600 standard development observations, 600 validation observations on 20 map-disjoint maps across 3 cached prompt styles, 160 development and 160 independently seeded validation fixture cases. Witness-only best robust cached runtime; exact LLM adds few certificates and overhead; frontier helps oracle-quality fixtures but can worsen real cached costs.
primary_claim: Geometry/certificate improvement. LLM-specific efficiency is not established by selection data. Report no-guidance ablation prominently.

fresh_protocol.native_sample: one query0 fixture per map, quality rotates by seed modulo4

confirmation_protocol: Previously opened session-1 test split: 600 cached observations across standard/cot/repe, 7 repeats, explicitly not fresh held-out evidence; no tuning afterwards.
timing_protocol: Primary fresh core and native timing runs sequentially, no concurrent benchmark/profile/analysis workers. Earlier exploratory/validation runs sometimes overlapped and are not final isolated timing claims.
